g_stack: GIS, Photogrammetry, Remote sensing, Drones/UAV, GNSS
eng: Georgia's national registry and mapping agency under the Ministry of Justice, responsible for the land/property cadastre, address registry, geodesy, topographic mapping and orthophoto production. It is the national NSDI coordinator and runs the national geoportal (maps.gov.ge), so geodata is a core output.
de: Georgiens nationale Registrier- und Vermessungsbehörde beim Justizministerium, zuständig für Liegenschaftskataster, Adressregister, Geodäsie, topografische Karten und Orthofotos. Sie koordiniert die nationale Geodateninfrastruktur (NSDI) und betreibt das Geoportal maps.gov.ge – Geodaten sind ein Kernprodukt.
notes: Address from napr.gov.ge personal-data page (own site). Size: ~1,400 employees per napr.gov.ge/en/about-agency. g_stack from NAPR presentations at UN-GGIM 2025 (photogrammetry, NSDI) and Geospatial World Forum (orthoimagery, aerial photography, drones, Geo-CORS, satellite imagery); no named software found. sprach null: no GIS job ad opened. Note: LinkedIn slug /company/napr is now titled 'National Agency for Sustainable Land Management and Land Use Monitoring' – not used here.

eng: State agency under Georgia's Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture running hydrometeorological, hydrological and geological monitoring and forecasting. Its Geology Department compiles the state geological maps and maintains a geological hazards GIS database and hazard zoning maps.
de: Staatliche Agentur des georgischen Umwelt- und Landwirtschaftsministeriums für hydrometeorologisches, hydrologisches und geologisches Monitoring und Prognosen. Die Geologie-Abteilung erstellt die staatlichen geologischen Karten und pflegt eine GIS-Datenbank zu geologische Gefahren sowie Gefahrenzonenkarten.
notes: Address and vacancy page from nea.gov.ge/En/Functions (own site; also devex). GIS evidence: nea.gov.ge/En/Departments/Geology ('Geological Hazards GIS database'); ArcMap named in NEA Geology Dept ICA 2024 abstract (ica-abs 7-44-2024). size null: not found. li_url null: no company page found (only personal profiles). sprach null: no GIS job ad seen.

key: GIS and RS Consulting Center GeoGraphic LLC|Tbilisi
c_name: GIS and RS Consulting Center GeoGraphic LLC
g_stack: ArcGIS, Leica, Photogrammetry, Remote sensing, GIS
eng: Private GIS and remote-sensing consultancy and the authorised Esri distributor in Georgia. Builds geoinformation systems and geodatabases, processes aerial and satellite imagery, produces orthophotos and maps, and offers certified Esri and Leica Geosystems software training.
de: Privates GIS- und Fernerkundungsberatungsunternehmen und autorisierter Esri-Distributor in Georgien. Entwickelt Geoinformationssysteme und Geodatenbanken, verarbeitet Luft- und Satellitenbilder, erstellt Orthofotos und Karten und bietet zertifizierte Esri- und Leica-Schulungen an.
notes: Address and Esri distributor status from geospatialworld.net company profile; services/Leica/ESRI from company profile PDF on envirogrids.net. Size 11-50 per developmentaid.org (village.ai: 20+). geographic.ge could not be opened (fetch blocked), so address not confirmed on own site. kp/li/sprach null: not found.

key: The Regional Environmental Centre for the Caucasus (REC Caucasus)|Tbilisi
c_name: The Regional Environmental Centre for the Caucasus (REC Caucasus)
eng: Regional non-profit environmental organisation headquartered in Tbilisi with offices in Yerevan and Baku, implementing donor-funded projects on climate, biodiversity, water and disaster risk. It recruits GIS/cartography experts for projects such as GEF-funded land and cadastre work.
de: Regionale gemeinnützige Umweltorganisation mit Sitz in Tbilisi und Büros in Jerewan und Baku, die Geberprojekte zu Klima, Biodiversität, Wasser und Katastrophenrisiko umsetzt. Für Projekte wie GEF-finanzierte Landnutzungs- und Katasterarbeiten stellt sie GIS-/Kartografie-Experten ein.
notes: Address from 2026 grievance-redress PDF on rec-caucasus.org (own site); older addresses differ (2019 vacancy: 13 B. Shoshitaishvili St; devex: 76c Chavchavadze Ave). GIS evidence & sprach from own-site GIS Expert vacancy (GEF project 5825, 2019): Georgian fluent required, English an asset; no software named. Size: devex 51-100. kp_url is parent of seen vacancies listing URL (…/vacancies/page/9).

eng: Tbilisi-based regional development and environmental NGO working on forests, natural hazards, climate and sustainable development in the South Caucasus. It builds geodatabases (wildfires, forest cover change, windbreaks, hazard zoning) from satellite imagery and runs a natural hazards and risks geoportal.
de: In Tbilisi ansässige regionale Entwicklungs- und Umwelt-NGO mit Schwerpunkt Wald, Naturgefahren, Klima und nachhaltige Entwicklung im Südkaukasus. Sie erstellt Geodatenbanken (Waldbrände, Waldbedeckung, Windschutzstreifen, Gefahrenzonen) aus Satellitendaten und betreibt ein Geoportal für Naturgefahren.
notes: Address/GIS work/stack from CENN's own presentation at EU ENI-SEIS roundtable (eionet.europa.eu PDF: ArcGIS imagery, Landsat/Sentinel/MODIS, geoportal drm.cenn.org); street also on madloba.info. cenn.org could not be opened (fetch blocked). size/kp/sprach null: not found.

eng: Georgia's national statistics office, producing official census, social, business and agricultural statistics. A GIS group in its IT department (13 GIS specialists and programmers for the 2024 census) builds census mapping, monitors fieldwork and publishes interactive grid-based maps and a GIS business-register map.
de: Nationales Statistikamt Georgiens, das amtliche Zensus-, Sozial-, Wirtschafts- und Agrarstatistiken erstellt. Eine GIS-Gruppe in der IT-Abteilung (13 GIS-Spezialisten und Programmierer für den Zensus 2024) erstellt Zensuskarten, überwacht die Feldarbeit und veröffentlicht interaktive Rasterkarten.
notes: Address from geostat.ge news 1048 (own site). GIS team & size (1,039 staff in 2023) from Georgia Strategic Review 2023 PDF on geostat.ge; GIS group also in ISI IPS073 paper. No GIS software named. kp_url null: only a single-vacancy page seen. sprach null.

key: Roads Department of the Ministry of Regional Development and Infrastructure of Georgia|Tbilisi
c_name: Roads Department of the Ministry of Regional Development and Infrastructure of Georgia
eng: Government body managing Georgia's international and secondary road network, including construction, maintenance and investment planning. Its Planning Unit runs the Road Asset Management System with GIS/CAD/HDM-4 specialists, using Esri GIS for asset data and spatial prioritisation of road works.
de: Staatliche Behörde für das internationale und sekundäre Straßennetz Georgiens (Bau, Unterhalt, Investitionsplanung). Die Planungseinheit betreibt das Straßenerhaltungsmanagementsystem mit GIS-/CAD-/HDM-4-Spezialisten und nutzt Esri-GIS für Anlagendaten und räumliche Priorisierung.
notes: Address from geospatialworld.net user profile and devex (not confirmed on own site; georoad.ge PDF fetch failed). g_stack from Roads Department's CAREC RAMS presentation (carecprogram.org 5_GEO-English_RAMS): ROMDAS, ESRI GIS, HDM-4, GIS/CAD specialists; planned cloud GIS portal and drones. size/kp/li/sprach null: not found.

g_stack: ArcGIS Pro, ArcMap, Drones/UAV, Photogrammetry, Total station
eng: Georgia's largest technical university. Its Department of Engineering Geodesy and Geoinformatics (Faculty of Mining, Geology and Sustainable Mountain Development) teaches engineering geodesy, cartography, photogrammetry and geoinformatics at bachelor's to doctoral level. The faculty hosts a GIS centre with ArcGIS Pro licences and a photogrammetric drone.
de: Größte technische Universität Georgiens. Der Lehrstuhl für Ingenieurgeodäsie und Geoinformatik (Fakultät für Bergbau, Geologie und nachhaltige Bergentwicklung) lehrt Ingenieurgeodäsie, Kartografie, Photogrammetrie und Geoinformatik vom Bachelor bis zum Doktorat. Die Fakultät verfügt über ein GIS-Zentrum mit ArcGIS-Pro-Lizenzen und Photogrammetrie-Drohne.
notes: Address from gtu.ge/mining/en/contact (own site; mailing postal code 0160, room address shows 0175; unirank also 0175). Dept info from gtu.ge dep6 page (21 staff, light distance meters/gyrotheodolites -> 'Total station' approximated). ArcGIS Pro/drone from TSU news article on GIS SKA; ArcMap from GTU-GIS course pages on GitHub Pages (ezdanapak.github.io/GTU-GIS, lecturer-run). Size: unirank 1,500-1,999 academic staff. kp/sprach null.

eng: Georgia's oldest and largest university. Its Vakhushti Bagrationi Institute of Geography and geography programmes (incl. a master's in geomorphology, cartography and landscape planning) produce national and regional atlases using GIS and host an international conference on cartography and GIS.
de: Älteste und größte Universität Georgiens. Das Vakhushti-Bagrationi-Institut für Geographie und die Geographieprogramme (u. a. Master in Geomorphologie, Kartografie und Landschaftsplanung) erstellen mit GIS nationale und regionale Atlanten und richten eine internationale Konferenz zu Kartografie und GIS aus.
notes: Address from TSU news page footer and icldscartogis.tsu.ge (own sites). g_stack from Vakhushti Bagrationi Institute ICA 2026 abstract (ArcGIS Pro, ArcMap for atlas). Size: WHED lists 564 full-time staff (2018-19). kp/sprach null: no GIS job ad seen.

eng: Public research university in Tbilisi. Its School of Natural Sciences and Medicine runs an Earth Sciences bachelor's with a Geography and GIS Technologies track, and its engineering school has a geomatics engineering group teaching surveying, drones, aerial photogrammetry and GIS.
de: Öffentliche Forschungsuniversität in Tbilisi. Die Fakultät für Naturwissenschaften und Medizin bietet einen Bachelor in Geowissenschaften mit Schwerpunkt Geographie und GIS-Technologien, und die Ingenieurfakultät hat eine Geomatik-Gruppe für Vermessung, Drohnen, Luftbildphotogrammetrie und GIS.
notes: Address from 2025 Incoming Erasmus Student Guide on iro.iliauni.edu.ge (own site; IRO postal address uses 0179). g_stack from iliauni.edu.ge Earth Sciences programme page (QGIS, ArcGIS, MICROMINE, Matlab) and faculty page (geomatics engineering: drones, aerial photogrammetry, GIS). Size: ~800 academic staff (wikiwand). kp/sprach null.

g_stack: GIS, Topcon, Sokkia, Carlson, GNSS, Drones/UAV, Remote sensing
eng: Tbilisi surveying and geoinformation company offering topographic and cadastral surveys, property-rights registration, GIS and geodatabase development, thematic mapping, UAV aerial photography and remote sensing. It also resells Topcon-Sokkia, Carlson, GMV and Satlab survey equipment and software.
de: Vermessungs- und Geoinformationsunternehmen in Tbilisi mit topografischen und Katastervermessungen, Eigentumsregistrierung, GIS- und Geodatenbankentwicklung, thematischer Kartierung, UAV-Luftbildern und Fernerkundung. Zudem Vertrieb von Topcon-Sokkia-, Carlson-, GMV- und Satlab-Produkten.
notes: All data from geospatialworld.net company profile (address, services, distributor lines, 11-50 employees). Legal form not found (c_name without legal form). tbilisigroup.ge could not be opened (fetch blocked). kp/li/sprach null.

eng: UN development agency country office in Tbilisi implementing governance, climate and disaster-risk programmes. It hires national GIS experts for projects such as the multi-hazard risk mapping programme for 11 river basins carried out with the National Environmental Agency.
de: Länderbüro der UN-Entwicklungsorganisation in Tbilisi mit Programmen zu Governance, Klima und Katastrophenrisiko. Für Projekte wie die Multi-Gefahren-Risikokartierung von 11 Flusseinzugsgebieten mit der Nationalen Umweltagentur stellt es nationale GIS-Experten ein.
notes: Address and jobs page from undp.org/georgia/contact-us (own site). GIS evidence/sprach from 'National GIS Expert' ad on impactpool (Tbilisi, Georgian & English required, GIS and remote sensing skills; no software named). size null: org-wide headcount not verified on a page.

key: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) – Representation in Georgia|Tbilisi
c_name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) – Representation in Georgia
eng: FAO's country office in Tbilisi (since 2004) supporting agriculture, land and forestry programmes with the Georgian government. It recruits national GIS and data specialists, e.g. for the land consolidation formulation project, working with ArcGIS and QGIS.
de: Länderbüro der FAO in Tbilisi (seit 2004), das Landwirtschafts-, Land- und Forstprogramme mit der georgischen Regierung unterstützt. Es stellt nationale GIS- und Datenspezialisten ein, etwa für das Flurbereinigungsprojekt, mit ArcGIS und QGIS.
notes: Address from ungeorgia.ge UN agencies page (UN Georgia site, not FAO's own); postal code not given -> null. GIS evidence/stack/sprach from 'National GIS and Data Specialist' ad (impactpool; project UTF/GEO/034/GEO-F, ArcGIS & QGIS, English C level). Further FAO Tbilisi GIS ads seen: National GIS and Land Use Planning Specialist, National GIS Land Use Specialist. size/kp/li null: not verified.

eng: State agency under the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture that manages Georgia's State Forest Fund. Its Forest Inventory Department organises forest inventory, management plans and cartographic materials, and its Forest Information and Cadaster Division runs the geo-information systems of the Forest Fund and prepares cadastral drawings.
de: Staatliche Agentur des Umwelt- und Landwirtschaftsministeriums, die den staatlichen Waldfonds Georgiens verwaltet. Die Abteilung Waldinventur erstellt Inventuren, Bewirtschaftungspläne und kartografische Materialien; die Abteilung Waldinformation und Kataster betreibt die Geoinformationssysteme des Waldfonds und erstellt Katasterpläne.
notes: Address + postal code from forestry.gov.ge (Departments / DepartmentDetails/8 footer). GIS evidence: forestry.gov.ge/En/DepartmentDetails/8 (Forest Inventory Department; Forest Information and Cadaster Division 'geo-informative systems of the Forest Fund'). g_stack only generic 'GIS' – no software named. size, kp_url, li_url, sprach null: not found (no LinkedIn company page in search results, no GIS job ads seen).

key: LEPL Agency of Protected Areas of Georgia|Tbilisi
c_name: LEPL Agency of Protected Areas of Georgia
eng: State agency that manages Georgia's strict nature reserves, national parks and other protected areas. It maintains boundary and trail data measured with high-precision GPS, digitises old paper maps, shares spatial data as Shapefile/KMZ/WMS and publishes an online map of protected territories.
de: Staatliche Agentur, die die Naturreservate, Nationalparks und weiteren Schutzgebiete Georgiens verwaltet. Sie erhebt Grenz- und Wegdaten mit hochpräzisem GPS, digitalisiert alte Papierkarten, teilt Geodaten als Shapefile/KMZ/WMS und veröffentlicht eine Online-Karte der Schutzgebiete.
notes: Address from apa.gov.ge footer (Georgian: Vladimer Tsitlanadze I shesakhvevi N1); postal code 0114 taken from forestry.gov.ge which lists the identical address (shared MEPA agency building) – apa.gov.ge itself gives no postal code. madloba.info lists an older address 6 Gulua St – not used. GIS evidence + g_stack: APA presentation at ENI SEIS II Georgia open-data roundtable (eni-seis.eionet.europa.eu, '9. Agency of Protected Areas - GE.pdf': Shapefile/MDB/KMZ/WMS, high-precision GPS, orthophotos, digitisation); map at apa.gov.ge/en/Home/MapInHome. No GIS unit listed among heads of units, hence 'Side tool'. kp_url from site footer. size/li_url/sprach not found.

key: LEPL National Agency for Sustainable Land Management and Land Use Monitoring|Tbilisi
c_name: LEPL National Agency for Sustainable Land Management and Land Use Monitoring
eng: State agency under the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture responsible for sustainable land management and monitoring of agricultural land use and soils. It is building a national Land Information System (with RMSI, under the World Bank-funded GRAIL project) that integrates land resource, soil and land-use data, and its staff co-authored a GIS of the landscapes of Georgia.
de: Staatliche Agentur des Umwelt- und Landwirtschaftsministeriums für nachhaltiges Landmanagement und die Überwachung von Landnutzung und Böden. Sie baut mit RMSI im Weltbank-Projekt GRAIL ein nationales Landinformationssystem auf, das Daten zu Landressourcen, Böden und Landnutzung integriert; Mitarbeitende sind Mitautoren eines GIS der Landschaften Georgiens.
notes: Address from madloba.info directory listing (no own website found in search; postal code not listed) – hence medium and c_url null. GIS evidence: ICA Abstracts 12/72 (2026) 'Geographical Information System of Landscapes of Georgia' (two authors affiliated with the agency); cbw.ge article on the national Land Information System (RMSI, GRAIL). g_stack generic, no software named. size/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

eng: The Ministry of Defence of Georgia runs a Geodesy Cartography Department that produces and maintains the military topographic maps of Georgia. Since 2017 it operates a digital cartographic GIS Portal for the MOD, and its staff publish on topographic mapping at ICA conferences.
de: Das Verteidigungsministerium Georgiens unterhält eine Abteilung für Geodäsie und Kartografie, die die militärischen topografischen Karten des Landes erstellt und pflegt. Seit 2017 betreibt sie ein digitales kartografisches GIS-Portal für das Ministerium; Mitarbeitende veröffentlichen zur topografischen Kartierung auf ICA-Konferenzen.
notes: GIS unit = Geodesy Cartography Department (not part of c_name). Evidence: ICA Abstracts 12/44 and 12/43 (2026), authors with mod.gov.ge addresses; 'GIS Portal for MOD' created 2017; GPS mentioned. Address/postal code/website from English Wikipedia (Ministry of Defence of Georgia) – not confirmed on mod.gov.ge (not fetched), hence medium. size '500+' inferred from Wikipedia armed-forces personnel figures (tens of thousands), ministry staff alone not stated. kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

eng: The executive body of Tbilisi Municipality. Its Urban Development Service (Urban Policy and Planning Department) is tasked with updating and systematising the city's geoinformation databases, and City Hall runs an interactive city map ('Smart Map') with layers on construction permits, tree-cutting permits and infrastructure works.
de: Exekutivorgan der Stadt Tiflis. Der Stadtentwicklungsdienst (Abteilung Stadtpolitik und Planung) ist für die Aktualisierung und Systematisierung der städtischen Geoinformationsdatenbanken zuständig; das Rathaus betreibt eine interaktive Stadtkarte ('Smart Map') mit Ebenen zu Baugenehmigungen, Baumfällungen und Infrastrukturprojekten.
notes: Address from matsne.gov.ge regulation of the Tbilisi City Hall Urban Development Service (doc 4569223, address 'J. Shartava St No. 7'; that regulation version was later replaced – GIS function still a reasonable indicator). Smart Map: Open Government Partnership commitment TBI0006 (lead: Tbilisi Municipal Services Development Agency) and bm.ge/georgiatoday.ge articles on construction-status map. Postal code and homepage not seen in sources (Wikipedia page fetch blocked), hence null. No software named. size/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

adress: Ketevan Dedofali Ave 59/4 (corner Lech Kaczynski St)
eng: Georgia's independent telecom and broadcasting regulator (ComCom / GNCC). It is building a broadband infrastructure mapping system with investment, demand, service and infrastructure maps (fibre lines, ducts, manholes, towers) and publishes an interactive analytics map of internet penetration; the project team includes a GIS programmer.
de: Unabhängige Regulierungsbehörde Georgiens für Telekommunikation und Rundfunk (ComCom / GNCC). Sie baut ein Breitband-Infrastruktur-Kartensystem mit Investitions-, Nachfrage-, Dienst- und Infrastrukturkarten (Glasfaser, Leerrohre, Schächte, Masten) auf und veröffentlicht eine interaktive Karte zur Internetdurchdringung; zum Projektteam gehört ein GIS-Programmierer.
notes: Address + postal code + LinkedIn from comcom.ge news page footer ('ComCom presents the digital map development initiative at the ITU meeting'). g_stack from GNCC presentation at ITU Regional Forum 2020 (Session 4, David Kutateladze – company talk): PostGIS, OpenStreetMap, QGIS; team incl. GIS programmer. size/kp_url/sprach not found.

key: LEPL National Agency for Cultural Heritage Preservation of Georgia|Tbilisi
c_name: LEPL National Agency for Cultural Heritage Preservation of Georgia
eng: State agency responsible for protecting and managing Georgia's immovable and movable cultural heritage and museum-reserves. Its Informational Systems Unit has a GIS complex data management team that develops and manages the Georgian Cultural Heritage Database Management System and GIS Portal covering monuments, protection zones, murals and museum collections.
de: Staatliche Agentur für den Schutz und die Verwaltung des georgischen Kulturerbes und der Museumsreservate. Ein GIS-Datenmanagementteam in ihrer Abteilung Informationssysteme entwickelt und betreibt das georgische Kulturerbe-Datenbanksystem mit GIS-Portal für Denkmäler, Schutzzonen, Wandmalereien und Museumsbestände.
notes: GIS evidence: Council of Europe page 'Creation of Cultural Heritage Database Management System and GIS Portal' (Informational Systems Unit, GIS complex data management team; project 2013–2017, Georgian-Norwegian follow-up from 2018). Address/postal code/website from English Wikipedia (not confirmed on own site), hence medium. No software named. size/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

key: Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture of Georgia|Tbilisi
c_name: Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture of Georgia
eng: Georgian ministry for environment, natural resources and agriculture, parent of the forestry, protected-areas and land-monitoring agencies. It publishes the Forest and Land Use Atlas (atlas.mepa.gov.ge), a web-based forest and land-use information and decision-support system, and hosts the hydromelioration and land management policy unit.
de: Georgisches Ministerium für Umwelt, natürliche Ressourcen und Landwirtschaft und Dachbehörde der Forst-, Schutzgebiets- und Landmonitoring-Agenturen. Es betreibt den Wald- und Landnutzungsatlas (atlas.mepa.gov.ge), ein webbasiertes Informations- und Entscheidungsunterstützungssystem, und beherbergt die Abteilung für Hydromelioration und Landmanagement.
notes: Address + postal code from mepa.gov.ge/En/AgenciesOfTheMinistry (Wikipedia gives an older address 6 Marshal Gelovani 0134 – not used). GIS evidence: mepa.gov.ge/En/Page/Forestandlanduseatlas, UNEP/agenda.ge news on the atlas, APA presentation citing atlas.mepa.gov.ge. Maintaining unit not named, hence 'Side tool'; 'WebGIS' = the online atlas. size/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

key: LEPL Spatial and Urban Development Agency|Tbilisi
c_name: LEPL Spatial and Urban Development Agency
eng: State agency (SUDA) under the Ministry of Economy and Sustainable Development responsible for national and municipal spatial planning and urban plans in Georgia. It manages its own geoinformation system and uses high-resolution aerial photos, LiDAR surveys and drones as data sources; it employs GIS specialists and consultants.
de: Staatliche Agentur (SUDA) des Wirtschaftsministeriums, zuständig für nationale und kommunale Raumplanung sowie Stadtpläne in Georgien. Sie betreibt ein eigenes Geoinformationssystem und nutzt hochauflösende Luftbilder, LiDAR-Befliegungen und Drohnen als Datenquellen; sie beschäftigt GIS-Spezialisten und -Berater.
notes: Legal address from agency statute on matsne.gov.ge (doc 5489858, Art. 1(7): Tbilisi, Sanapiro St No. 2); GIS function in Art. 4 (managing the agency's geoinformation system, Administrative Department). g_stack from SUDA presentation at ADB event Nov 2024 (events.development.asia: aerial photos, LiDAR, drones; GIS Specialist and GIS Consultant listed). Website from ECTP-CEU member page. Postal code not found; medium because address from legal register, not own site. size/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

eng: Tbilisi technology company that develops and operates autonomous and remotely piloted aerial vehicles and carries out topographic surveying and environmental monitoring with IoT sensors. It is a reseller/distributor for drone and photogrammetry vendors such as Parrot, senseFly and Pix4D.
de: Technologieunternehmen in Tiflis, das autonome und ferngesteuerte Fluggeräte entwickelt und betreibt sowie topografische Vermessungen und Umweltmonitoring mit IoT-Sensoren durchführt. Es ist Wiederverkäufer bzw. Distributor für Drohnen- und Photogrammetrieanbieter wie Parrot, senseFly und Pix4D.
notes: All data from Geospatial World company profile (resource.geospatialworld.net/company/ngs-lab): address 'Chavchavadze 39, Tbilisi', size 11-50, services incl. topographic surveying, partners Parrot/senseFly/Pix4D. Own site ngslab.ge could not be fetched (permission not granted), so address not confirmed on own site and legal form unknown; 'Pix4D' named only as reseller partner, so g_stack kept generic (Photogrammetry). Postal code/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

eng: Authorised DJI dealer in Georgia that imports and distributes drones and provides repairs, technical support and pilot training. Through its Mega Geohub shop it sells geodetic and GIS/mapping equipment and software, including GNSS receivers, optical survey instruments, photogrammetry drones and LiDAR, for cadastre, construction and remote-sensing users.
de: Autorisierter DJI-Händler in Georgien, der Drohnen importiert und vertreibt sowie Reparaturen, technischen Support und Pilotenschulungen anbietet. Über den Shop Mega Geohub verkauft das Unternehmen Geodäsie- und GIS/Mapping-Ausrüstung und Software, darunter GNSS-Empfänger, optische Vermessungsinstrumente, Photogrammetrie-Drohnen und LiDAR, für Kataster-, Bau- und Fernerkundungskunden.
notes: Address, postal code, size, website from Geospatial World company profile (copter-tech). megageohub.ge product page names seller 'LTD Copter tech' and lists GNSS, optical surveying instruments, GIS & Mapping software, DJI Zenmuse P1, Stonex XFLY 120 LiDAR, DJI Matrice 350 RTK; megageohub gives a different address (Vasil Barnovi St 71, 0179 – possibly showroom), so address not confirmed on own site. kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

eng: Small geodetic company in Tbilisi offering land measurement, boundary determination and topographic surveys. A company geodesist co-authored the 2026 ICA paper on a Geographical Information System of the Landscapes of Georgia together with GTU and the national land-monitoring agency.
de: Kleines Geodäsieunternehmen in Tiflis für Grundstücksvermessung, Grenzfeststellung und topografische Aufnahmen. Ein Geodät des Unternehmens ist Mitautor des ICA-Beitrags 2026 über ein Geoinformationssystem der Landschaften Georgiens, gemeinsam mit der GTU und der nationalen Landmonitoring-Agentur.
notes: Address from madloba.info directory listing (no own website found); GIS evidence from ICA Abstracts 12/72 (2026) affiliation 'Geodetic company GT Survey, Tbilisi'. Legal form unknown. g_stack generic. size/postal code/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

key: NACRES – Centre for Biodiversity Conservation and Research|Tbilisi
c_name: NACRES – Centre for Biodiversity Conservation and Research
eng: Georgian conservation NGO founded in 1989 that works on rare and endangered mammals and human-wildlife conflict species (wolves, brown bears, leopards) across the South Caucasus. As technical lead of Georgia's Emerald Network project it produced GIS distribution maps for habitats and site map layers delivered to the European Environment Agency.
de: Georgische Naturschutz-NGO (gegründet 1989), die sich mit seltenen und bedrohten Säugetieren sowie Konfliktarten wie Wolf, Braunbär und Leopard im Südkaukasus befasst. Als technische Leiterin des georgischen Emerald-Network-Projekts erstellte sie GIS-Verbreitungskarten für Lebensräume und Gebietskartenebenen für die Europäische Umweltagentur.
notes: GIS evidence only from Council of Europe 'Report 2013 Emerald developments NACRES' (GIS distribution maps for 15 habitats; the two GIS specialists in the team were from GIS-Lab Ltd, not NACRES) – evidence dated, hence low. Address conflict: eco-web.com Green Pages gives Besarion Jgenti St 29, PO Box 20, Tbilisi 0183 (used); caucasus-mt.net gives Irakli Abashidze St 12a – current office unverified. Website from IUCN member page. size/kp_url/li_url/sprach not found.

eng: T-Mobile Austria GmbH, trading as Magenta Telekom, is one of Austria's largest telecom operators, providing mobile, cable, fibre and internet services to private and business customers. It has its headquarters in Vienna. It employs GIS staff who manage and analyse geodata for its network and internal clients, using Esri ArcGIS and building on the ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript and Python.
de: Die T-Mobile Austria GmbH (Magenta Telekom) ist einer der größten Telekommunikationsanbieter Österreichs und bietet Mobilfunk, Kabel-, Glasfaser- und Internetdienste für Privat- und Geschäftskunden an. Der Hauptsitz liegt in Wien. GIS-Mitarbeiter:innen betreuen und analysieren Geodaten für Netz und interne Kunden auf Basis von Esri ArcGIS, ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript und Python.
notes: Legal name and address (T-Mobile Austria GmbH, Rennweg 97-99, 1030 Wien) from own data-protection page magenta.at/datenschutzinfos, which also names the trading name Magenta Telekom. The address also appears in the karriere.at profile (karriere.at/f/magenta-telekom) and the devjobs.at ad. g_stack is from the 'GIS-Mitarbeiter:in' ad, Rennweg 97, 1030 Wien, on en.devjobs.at/job/ff880c6ed257186798130b6795376483 and remotive.com: 'fundierte ESRI ArcGIS-Kenntnisse', basic programming in ArcGIS Maps SDK/API for JavaScript and Python. karriere.at also listed this ad under Wien (now expired). sprach DE: the ad is written in German but states no explicit language requirement. Size: about 2,200 employees per own newsroom page (newsroom.magenta.at 'Über Magenta Telekom'), and 501-2500 per karriere.at. kp_url and li_url are linked from that newsroom page. Sector 'Other' because telecom is not in the allowed list.

key: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)|Vienna
c_name: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA)
eng: IIASA is an independent international research institute that carries out systems analysis on climate, energy, land use, biodiversity and population for governments and international organisations. It is based in Laxenburg Palace, about 15 km south of Vienna. Spatial data analysts and modellers in programs such as Biodiversity and Natural Resources build gridded land-use and biosphere datasets with GIS and R/Python tools.
de: Das IIASA ist ein unabhängiges internationales Forschungsinstitut, das Systemanalysen zu Klima, Energie, Landnutzung, Biodiversität und Bevölkerung für Regierungen und internationale Organisationen erstellt. Sitz ist Schloss Laxenburg, rund 15 km südlich von Wien. Spatial Data Analysts und Modellierer:innen, etwa im Programm Biodiversity and Natural Resources, erstellen räumliche Landnutzungs- und Biosphärendatensätze mit GIS sowie R und Python.
notes: Located in Laxenburg (Lower Austria), right next to Vienna, not inside the city. Address (Schlossplatz 1, A-2361 Laxenburg) from own site footer (iiasa.ac.at/employment/onboarding-documents); 'about 15 km from Vienna' from iiasa.ac.at/employment/working-at-iiasa. g_stack from IIASA BNR program 'Spatial data analyst' ad, Integrated Biosphere Futures group, Laxenburg, deadline 15 May 2024, seen on uncareer.net (vacancy 676387): R spatial packages (GDAL, raster, sf), GIS software such as QGIS or ArcGIS, Python as an asset; 'excellent written and spoken English'. This ad is dated 2024 and no current GIS ad was opened. sprach ENG: also, the IIASA employment FAQ (iiasa.ac.at/employment/frequently-asked-questions-faqs) gives the working language as English. Legal form: an association under Austrian law (independent NGO, per the same FAQ); the name has no legal-form suffix. Size: 'In 2025, IIASA employed 470 individuals representing 61 nationalities' (IIASA Annual Report 2025, iiasa.ac.at/sites/default/files/2026-06/IIASA_AR_2025_web.pdf). kp_url: own 'Join us' page, which is mainly the YSSP call and talent pool; vacancies run on iiasa.onlyfy.jobs. li_url null: no IIASA LinkedIn company page in search results or on the pages opened, and iiasa.ac.at could not be fetched directly to check footer links.

Size: 'Unternehmensgröße 501 - 2500' on the karriere.at employer profile (karriere.at/f/bundesanstalt-statistik-österreich). The own careers page statistik.at/en/about-us/careers/attractive-employer gives no headcount.
Size: 'The Environment Agency Austria employs 694 experts' (as of 12/2025, excluding external project staff) on own page umweltbundesamt.at/en/about-us.
